instrument: Responsible Data Center Development Act, S10642/A11560 (passed June 4, 2026)
summary: Passed the Senate 44-16 and Assembly 102-39 on June 4, 2026: a one-year moratorium on DEC permits for large data centers of 20 MW or more peak demand, with a 1 MW definition of data center and energy-law obligations from 5 MW. Not signed; on July 14 the Governor instead issued Executive Order 62 (50 MW), her office describing the bill as needing more work.

source.citation: DLA Piper (July 1), Harris Beach (July 18), Greenberg Traurig (June 12), NBC News (July 14), Governor's release (July 14)
